title: VTG Donkey Kong Atari 2600 Coleco Nintendo Video Game Cartridge 1982 Tested
descriptionText:
VTG Donkey Kong video game cartridge for Atari 2600 produced by Coleco under Nintendo license. Classic arcade platformer release from 1982.
Cartridge shows cosmetic wear including label edge wear and discoloration to the plastic shell consistent with age. Game has not been tested and is being sold as is unless otherwise noted.
Please review all photos carefully for condition and exact item you will receive.
